bundle_path.description: Local OKF bundle root path (up to 4096 characters where constrained); server enforces root and symlink boundaries. Example: /workspace/knowledge.

from.description: Source version: auto (default), 0.1 or 0.2; auto resolves from the bundle.

generated_by.description: Producer provenance for migrated generated fields, e.g. human:reviewer; not an authorization principal.

generated_at.description: Explicit per-concept generated timestamps (RFC 3339 date-time); no inferred time is supplied.

timestamp_conflict_policy.description: How to resolve an existing timestamp versus generated.at; reject by default.

timestamp_policy.description: Preserve legacy timestamp or remove it after copying to generated.at; required.

citation_mappings.description: Explicit citation mappings with replay-sufficient selectors; use exact legacy_entry bytes or resource projection for reserved index/log documents.

computations.description: Explicit attested computation mappings; computation content is inert and is never executed by this tool.
